name: B10-0115/2025 (PfE) – Recent dismissals and arrests of mayors in Türkiye
title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on the recent dismissals and arrests of mayors in Türkiye
part_text:
The European Parliament is calling on Turkey to stop dismissing and arresting elected mayors and to drop what it calls politically motivated charges against them. It says human rights and the rule of law in Turkey are getting worse, and that the government is silencing its critics. It also asks the European Commission and EU governments to consider ending Turkey's EU membership talks and cutting pre-accession money. The text is an opinion and a request; it does not change any law by itself.

- Nothing changes yet; the Parliament only states its position and asks EU governments and the Commission to act.
- It concerns the Turkish government, arrested mayors, and Turkey's EU funding and membership talks.
- Next, the text goes to EU governments, the Commission and Turkish authorities; they decide whether to act.
